content: Sticky workout logging UX patterns: (1) Previous performance displayed inline — most important feature; (2) PR notifications provide dopamine/habit reinforcement; (3) Rest timer with in-notification logging (log next set without opening app) reduces friction; (4) Gamification (streaks, badges) increases engagement ~30%; (5) Simplicity beats novelty — simpler loggers beat feature-rich ones for retention; (6) Athletes who log consistently are 42% more likely to adhere long-term. Logging from a notification is a strong differentiator for set completion flow.
